title: St Egwin's Church, Norton and Lenchwick - WW2 Wellington Memorial
memorial_details: description: On March 1st 1945/  a Wellington aircraft/ from 24 OTU,/ RAF Honeybourne,/ crashed in this village/ and the entire Canadian/ crew of five were killed/ This plaque and the/ Maple tree nearby is/ dedicated to their/ memory/ They were:/ (Names)/ They gave their lives/ for us //
